name: Foldfly
summary: A coral Send button that creases, folds into a paper dart and throws your note
about: The Send button is drawn as a sheet of paper. Your note lifts out of the box into it, then the sheet creases and snaps through three folds into a dart, winds up and is thrown. The note lands as a chat bubble with paper confetti and a Delivered tick, a reply arrives, and the button unfolds again. Made for contact forms, chat boxes and quick-reply widgets.
how: Type a note (or keep the sample) and press Send note, or Ctrl + Enter in the box.
The text lifts out of the box and shrinks into the button while it squashes.
A crease line flashes before each fold and the sheet tilts and snaps from square to triangle to dart.
The dart winds back and is thrown off the screen; the note lands as a bubble with paper confetti and a Delivered tick.
Bilal types and replies, and the dart springs back and unfolds into the button. An empty box makes the button shake instead.
